messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx and timeouts observed for /v1/generate on model=redwood-7b-q across us-west-2. Error rate spike started ~2026-03-14T13:42:10Z. Relevant alert: https://grafana.company/local/d/llm/runtime-errors

incident-bot: Pager triggered by rule: runtime.error_rate > 5% for 3m AND http.status >= 500 count rising. Pager: devon_oncall, nora_pager.

devon_oncall: ack. I'm looking. tagging @timothy_sre and @mike_infra for infra hints.

sara_ops: seeing an abrupt jump in 5xx at 13:42:07 UTC. sample logs from gateway: `2026-03-14T13:42:12Z ERROR handler.go:143 status=502 backend=runtime node=gpu-worker-17` then a bunch of `segfault`/`OOM` from the runner.

mike_infra: checked node logs — multiple SIGSEGV in `model_runner` process. dmesg snippet:
```
Mar 14 13:42:11 gpu-worker-17 kernel: model_runner[4213]: segfault at 0 ip 00007f9c4a1b3f02 sp 00007ffcd3b51fb0 error 4 in libattention.so[7f9c49f00000+2b000]
Mar 14 13:42:12 gpu-worker-17 systemd[1]: model-runner.service: Main process exited, code=killed, status=11/SEGV
Mar 14 13:42:13 gpu-worker-17 kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 4213 (model_runner) score 900 or sacrifice child
```
Coredump path: `/var/lib/systemd/coredump/core.model_runner.4213`

devon_oncall: running `kubectl -n runtime get pods -l model=redwood-7b-q -o wide` now. Several pods in CrashLoopBackOff and evicted.

devon_oncall: quick mitigation plan: 1) isolate traffic away from redwood-7b-q 2) route to fallback model `redwood-7b-q-quant` or `redwood-7b-lr` 3) restart affected nodes with eviction delay 4) enable mem guardrails on runner.

timothy_sre: +1. For immediate customer-facing stability we should do live routing change at the gateway level. Use admin API: `POST /admin/routes/override` with payload `{ "match": "/v1/generate","model": "redwood-7b-q","route_to": "redwood-7b-q-quant" }`

timothy_sre: example curl (run from ops-runbook container):
```
curl -s -X POST "https://gateway-admin.us-west-2.internal/admin/routes/override" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"match":"/v1/generate","model":"redwood-7b-q","route_to":"redwood-7b-q-quant","reason":"runtime_suspected_segfault" }'
```

devon_oncall: applied override, confirmed all new traffic hitting `redwood-7b-q-quant`. watch window starting now.

sara_ops: verified in grafana: error rate dropped from 32% -> 4% within 60s of the override. Latency slightly up (~120ms) but acceptable.

mike_infra: scheduling rolling reboot for gpu-worker-17/18/19; they're the ones with repeated OOM/segfault stacks. Will cordon and drain 1 at a time.

devon_oncall: running sanity checks on affected pods, pulled a core, uploading to /tmp/coredumps and triggering ablation-run locally for repro.

mike_infra: found a pattern — failures coincide with token-length spikes (inputs > 12k tokens). Kernel oom triggered on linear attention kernel in libattention. Short-term fix: enforce request token cap at edge for this model.

devon_oncall: implemented rate-limited trimming policy in gateway for `redwood-7b-q` override to `max_input_tokens=8192` on fallback route in case of backfill.

lynn_prod: customer impact: CS picked up error reports from `acme-corp` on API errors ~13:43 UTC. They reported ~5% of requests failing. Any ETA for full recovery?

aj_customer_success: drafting message to affected customers: "We're aware of elevated 5xx on /v1/generate for models in the 7b family. Traffic has been routed to fallback quantized variants; you may see slightly higher latency. We're investigating root cause and will follow up with remediation timeline." Posting under #customers-outages?

devon_oncall: ETA: monitoring for 15m after routing change, then decide on progressive rollout back to primary model once patched. If error rate stays <1% we can start canary on 1% traffic.

nora_pager: handoff planned in ~30m. devon, please include runbook pointer and current actions in the handoff.

devon_oncall: handoff notes:
- Current state: traffic routed to `redwood-7b-q-quant`, error rate 0.8% (dashboard link).
- Actions taken: gateway override, node cordon/drain (workers 17/18 rebooted), temporary token cap enforcement, mem-guardrails enabled in runner config (uLimit/RSS cap).
- Next steps: collect core dumps + stack traces, reproduce locally with token-length fixture, prepare hotfix of attention kernel or rollback to older runtime build.
- Runbook: https://wiki.company/runbooks/runtime-segfaults

devon_oncall: logs and short commands for handoff:
```
# check pods
kubectl -n runtime get pods -l model=redwood-7b-q -o wide
# routing override status
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" https://gateway-admin.us-west-2.internal/admin/routes/override/status
# memguard status
kubectl -n runtime exec -it model-runner-xxxxx -- cat /etc/runner/memguard.conf
```

aj_customer_success: sent initial notify to affected customers (list attached to support ticket #SUP-98765). Will post updates as we know more.

timothy_sre: logging note — please tag all commits/changes with incident id `INC-3723456789` for postmortem correlation.

incident-bot: Update: error rate back to baseline (0.5%) at 13:58 UTC after reroute + reboots. Pager auto-clear scheduled in 10m if no regressions.

devon_oncall: I'll start a post-incident thread with repro steps and attach cores/trace. If SRE wants to take over long-term root cause, please escalate.

nora_pager: thanks for the handoff. I will monitor the watch window and pick up if anything resurges. Closing on-call in 25m if stable. :white_check_mark:

mike_infra: created infra ticket INFRA-5491 to track kernel/attention lib patch and node health checks.

devon_oncall: summary for postmortem: probable kernel memory blowup in attention kernel when handling very long contexts, leading to OOM and segfaults in model_runner; mitigations were routing to quantized fallback, token-length caps, node reboots, memguard enablement.

incident-bot: Incident cleared: no active alerts for rule runtime.error_rate > 5% for 5m. Incident duration ~16m.
